title: 1811 Prairie's north pinnacle stops under its block
items: The north pinnacle on 1811 Prairie's stone gable now stops at a carved band level with the gable's cornice, as the 1888 Inland Architect plate draws it, about half a metre lower than before; over the band a scaled stone leans in to the moulded block, and the gable's eave dies into it instead of showing beside the shaft.
